rules: Use Fredoka for all headings (H1-H4), buttons, and numbers.
Use Nunito for supporting body text, descriptions, and minor labels.
Never use default sans-serif (like Inter or Roboto) for primary UI elements in this app.

visual_enhancers.buttons: transform transition-all active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#1D3557]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid, opaque colors to maintain the high-contrast neo-brutalist cartoon feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with stroke-width 2.5 or 3 for a chunkier feel, colored in #1D3557. Use emojis purely as playful decorative elements.

MoneyJars.purpose: Dashboard visual representation of account balances.
MoneyJars.layout: Grid layout. Each jar is a vertical flex container.
MoneyJars.structure: Container with thick border, text above/below, and a central 'Jar' element.
MoneyJars.jar_visual: A div with fixed w-20 h-28, border-[3px] border-[#1D3557], rounded-b-2xl rounded-t-md bg-white relative overflow-hidden shadow-inner.
MoneyJars.fill_technique: Inner div absolute at bottom-0, w-full, with dynamic inline style `height: ${percent}%`. Use distinct bright colors for each account type's liquid (e.g., green for Piggy Bank, blue for Wallet). Add a subtle CSS transition `transition-[height] duration-1000 ease-out` on mount.

MissionCards.layout: Flex column on mobile, row on desktop. White background, thick border, hard shadow.
anatomy: Icon Block: A vibrant colored square/circle (e.g., #FFD23F) holding a Lucide icon representing the subject.
Content Block: Bold Mission Title (Fredoka), subtle subject label.
Due Date Badge: Small pill shape with clock icon, colored orange (#EE6C4D) if urgent, otherwise secondary (#3D5A80).
Action Button: Chunky button saying 'Open Mission 🚀' or 'Start' utilizing the visual_enhancers buttons classes.

JourneyMap.layout: Vertical timeline. Use flex-col with gap-12. Topics alternate left/right using `self-start ml-4` and `self-end mr-4`.
JourneyMap.node_anatomy: Circular or squircle nodes. Thick borders. Contains the topic icon.

states.locked: bg-[#E0FBFC] border-[#A8B8D0] text-[#A8B8D0] shadow-none opacity-80. Display a Lock icon.
states.unlocked_current: bg-[#FFD23F] border-[#1D3557] shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#1D3557] scale-110 animate-pulse. Add a floating map marker or star above it.
states.completed: bg-[#06D6A0] text-white border-[#1D3557] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1D3557]. Display a Checkmark.

JourneyMap.connector_line: Absolute SVG or CSS dashed border connecting nodes vertically behind them (z-[-1]). Use stroke-[#1D3557] and stroke-width-4.

BigWinCelebration.trigger: Fire confetti on specific state changes (goal hit 100%, badge array length increases).
BigWinCelebration.audio: Play a cheerful 'Ta-Da' sound. Ensure volume is reasonable.
BigWinCelebration.mute_toggle: Floating button fixed to bottom-right or header: `🔊/🔇`. Reads from/writes to `localStorage.getItem('coinquest_mute')`. Default to unmuted (false).

motion.hover_effects: Translate Y and shadow size changes (see visual enhancers).
motion.current_level: Bounce or pulse animation to attract attention.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain thick #1D3557 borders around all interactive elements ensuring WCAG AAA contrast against light backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` to all interactable items (mission cards, jars, map nodes, mute toggle).

media.audio_notes: Use this free mixkit positive notification sound or similar for the celebration.

3d_libraries.usage: Not required. Use pure CSS, canvas-confetti, and 2D Lucide icons to maintain the flat Neo-Brutalist cartoon style.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add `canvas-confetti` and `lucide-react` via yarn if not present.
THEME CONTEXT: Use the colors and visual enhancers specified above across all new components.
SOUND CONTEXT: Create a useCelebration hook or Context that manages the sound object and confetti function. It should expose a `playCelebration()` function and a `toggleMute()` function.
COMPONENT 1: Modify the MyMoney dashboard card. Map through the balances and render a Flex Row/Grid of vertical jars. Implement the inline style height calculation safely.
COMPONENT 2: Refactor `ChildHomework` to map over the missions and render chunky MissionCards. Use solid background colors like white or pale cyan for the card body.

COMPONENT 3: Refactor `LearnPage.jsx`. Implement the winding path. A simple CSS way is a wrapper div with relative positioning, mapping the nodes with alternating `items-start` and `items-end`, and drawing an absolute SVG line top-to-bottom behind them.
Do NOT use inline styles for anything other than dynamic variables like the Jar fill percentage or dynamic SVG path coordinates.
Do NOT use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur). Adhere strictly to the solid, playful, Neo-Brutalist aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all buttons and interactive cards have the thick border and solid hard shadow defined in visual_enhancers.
Colors should not be used as gradients. Use solid block colors.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for any overlapping content or dropdowns.
Icons should use chunky stroke widths (2.5 or 3).
